About MedFind AI

Healthcare starts with finding the right person.

MedFind AI helps patients search for an appropriate specialist, compare clear profiles, and reserve an available appointment slot.

1. AskDescribe the specialist you need
2. CompareReview profiles, ratings, fees, and timings
3. BookSelect a time and receive confirmation
Need help?

Safety & support

MedFind AI is for finding and booking doctors. It does not diagnose conditions or replace emergency care.

For a real emergency, contact your local emergency service or visit the nearest emergency department.

For the hackathon demo, this page shows the safety message your product should always include.
